name: ONEPLUSONE
source:
You play as a college student haunted by a dark incident involving a serial killer. Your choices shape the story and determine which of the four endings you reach. Along the way, you may even come face to face with the person behind it all…

[From [url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/oneplusone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名大学生，被连环杀手的黑暗事件所困扰。你的选择塑造了故事并决定了你达到的四个结局中的哪一个。一路上，你甚至可能会遇到这一切的幕后黑手……

[来自[url=https://yummydoesstuff.itch.io/oneplusone]Itch.io[/url]]
